Armed with a Doctorate in English Literature, Dr. Kiran Krishna set out to ensure rural students access the same opportunities as their urban counterparts. When unreliable transport kept classrooms empty, she realized that true education begins the moment a child leaves home. Today, she guarantees a secure, reliable ride for every student in a Tata Winger. Unsung heroes like Dr. Kiran proves that a single citizen's dedication is the foundation of a child's future; Kyunki Bharat humse aage badhta hai.
